title: Bar Salts Pink Lemonade Flavour Concentrate 10ml By Vampire Vape
description: Experience the vibrant and refreshing summer flavours of Pink Lemonade with this flavour concentrate from Vampire Vape's Bar Salts collection. This 10ml bottle captures the essence of a sweet and tangy pink lemonade, blending a slight citrus bite with a hint of red fruit for a perfectly balanced vape experience. Ideal for DIY vapers looking to mix their own e-liquids, this concentrate provides a strong base flavour that can be diluted to suit your taste preferences. Simply add nicotine shots and a VG/PG base to craft an e-liquid that's exactly right for your vaping style. Designed for vapers who enjoy crafting their blends, this 100% PG concentrate provides the foundation for a personalized vape experience. Adjust the nicotine level and VG/PG ratios to your liking by adding nicotine shots and a VG/PG base to achieve the perfect balance. Mix this concentrate with a VG/PG base of your choice and add nicotine shots as desired to achieve your perfect vape, with recommended dilution rates between 15-20% to suit your taste. Produced in the UK, this high-quality concentrate is designed for optimal flavour accuracy and mixing versatility. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
